brief:
Pete Hegseth, US Secretary of Defence, confirmed Tuesday that he visited American troops stationed in Israel and held a private meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Middle East Eye reported. Hegseth declined to discuss specifics of his conversation with Netanyahu.

The trip comes as the US maintains a military presence in Israel during its operations in Gaza and amid regional tensions.
dek: Hegseth confirms he visited Israel, spoke to Netanyahu US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth confirmed on Tuesday that he visited US troops in Israel and said he would not discuss the details of a private conversation with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
title: US Defence Secretary Hegseth visits Israel, meets Netanyahu
